idempotencyBehaviour.analysisRunIdentity: stable exact-project/BOM source fingerprint + analysis version + canonical snapshot SHA-256
idempotencyBehaviour.proposalStateIdentity: separately versioned live overlay excluded from the analysis run key
idempotencyBehaviour.rerun: Locally present projects make no Jetbuilt request; created proposals and preserved failures are returned instead of recreated.

resumabilityBehaviour.completedCandidates: Detected from proposal identities and generation keys.
resumabilityBehaviour.validationFailures: Complete attempted payload and exact issues persist as validation-failed per run/candidate.
resumabilityBehaviour.interruptedAcquisition: Failed sync run is retained; a later exact-project rerun succeeds independently.

qualityGates: no exact existing proposal or declared proposal alias
at least one caller-marked official HTTP(S) evidence reference
caller-declared complete physical ports or explicit not-applicable
caller-declared complete dimensions or explicit unavailable
caller confirmation that no valid data was omitted

epsonFailureDiagnosis.representativeRegression: A complete Epson EB-810E fixture with connectorType 3.5mm is rejected as Unknown connectorType; its full two-port payload is preserved unchanged and no proposal is created.

recommendedNextStep: Review the diff, then deploy the API migration and proposal-identity endpoint through the normal reviewed release path before claiming production one-hit support.
